description: Java class TSProjectConsumer implementing ConfigurationConsumer for processing and generating configuration files, specifically handling TunerStudio configuration sections within a larger project.

classes.name: TSProjectConsumer
classes.description: Handles reading, processing, and writing TunerStudio configuration sections within a project.

methods.name: writeTunerStudioFile
methods.description: Generates a TunerStudio configuration file with headers, footers, and content based on input parameters.

methods.name: readTsFile
methods.description: Reads a TunerStudio file, extracting prefix and postfix sections based on start/end tags.

methods.name: endFile
methods.description: Finalizes processing by writing the TunerStudio file.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Handles end of a configuration structure, updates total size, and registers it.
